name: Patience
summary: In Tirisfal Glades, Executor Zygand waits for overdue field reports. He sends you to gather updates from Deathguards near Brill and a sentry by Stillwater Pond.

sections.title: Enforcing the Dark Lady's Will
sections.body: Executor Zygand commands local security in Tirisfal Glades and allows no lapse in vigilance. Serving Lady Sylvanas, he expects every duty done without fail. When scheduled field reports do not reach his post, he treats the delay as a breach of duty. He stays at his post and sends Forsaken agents to find the tardy subordinates and keep the borders secure.

sections.title: Sentinels of the Glades
sections.body: Sentries at key points around Brill owe Zygand their reports. Deathguard Dillinger watches the graveyard west of town, where rogue undead and Scourge remnants stir. East of Brill, Deathguard Kristof guards a waystation on the approaches to the Capital City and the eastern roads. Gordo is the strangest sentry: a hulking abomination who wanders near Stillwater Pond, where military record-keeping seems a poor fit for his simple mind.

faq.answer: Executor Zygand commands security around Brill in Tirisfal Glades. He serves in the Forsaken command hierarchy under Lady Sylvanas and demands flawless work from the troops under his watch.

faq.q: Why does Zygand send an adventurer to collect reports?
faq.answer: Several field sentries have missed their scheduled reports. Zygand stays at his central post and sends newly proven Forsaken to collect the overdue dispatches across the countryside.

faq.q: Who is Gordo and why does he have a report?
aliases: why does an abomination have a report
faq.answer: Gordo is an abomination who wanders near Stillwater Pond. Zygand expected a report from him like those of the other sentries, then saw the folly of expecting written intelligence from an abomination.
Deathguard Dillinger watches near the graveyard west of Brill, where he monitors Scourge activity and newly risen corpses.
Deathguard Kristof guards a waystation on the road east of Brill, watching the approaches and road traffic.

faq.q: What happens when Gordo's report is turned in?
faq.answer: Zygand admits that expecting a coherent written report from an abomination was foolish. He accepts the outcome quietly and asks you to keep the embarrassing mistake between you and him.

angles.text: As a newly liberated Forsaken, carrying out Zygand's orders shows the harsh terms of survival in Lordaeron: devotion to the Dark Lady and no tolerance for failure.
As a Horde ally, you see the grim discipline Sylvanas Windrunner's officers enforce throughout Tirisfal.
